- Provides clear workflow steps, validation criteria, and output expectations for users seeking work-productivity solutions related to Google Workspace and CLI environments.
- Includes example triggers and keyword support to activate when relevant skill patterns or practical workflow assistance is needed.

- Initial release of "work-productivity-gog-google-workflow-helper" skill.
- Helps users implement, fix, and improve Gog-style workflows for Google Workspace contexts, with proven demand.
